name: jelly-radio

frames.best_why: The chosen pill is lit white and swollen with its neighbours pushed aside, and no cursor covers the row.

tagline: The chosen pill swells white and shoves its neighbours aside.
summary: A single-choice row of rounded chips where the selected one grows, turns light and pushes the others outward with a springy wobble. Arrow keys move the choice.
appearance: A horizontal row of rounded dark-grey pill chips with white labels, one lit to a solid white fill with dark text and standing slightly taller and wider. The neighbours sit evenly spaced on a near-black stage, with a small prompt above and a large value below.
behaviour: Clicking a chip springs the highlight to it: the chosen pill swells, flips to white and pushes the pills on either side outward while they shrink slightly. The group settles with a light jelly wobble, and arrow keys move the selection.
demo_content: Plan names Hobby, Starter, Pro, Team and Enterprise with monthly prices $0, $9, $24, $59 and Custom.
search_phrases: radio chips that grow when selected
single choice buttons in a row
options that push each other away
use_when: A small, fixed set of options needs a single choice with a tactile, attention-drawing highlight.
avoid_when: The swelling and pushing need horizontal room; many options or long labels overflow narrow screens.
customise: Items, value/defaultValue, onChange, chip and active colours, text colours, size, gap, radius, swell, barge, shrink, jelly, bounce, stagger, stiffness and disabled are props.
weight_why: Only a handful of chips with spring transforms; it idles once settled.

a11y.note: Radio roles and arrow-key control are solid, but the focused chip shows no visible focus ring, only the selected fill.

issues: The focused chip has its outline removed with no visible focus ring to replace it.
polish_why: Crisp pills and a satisfying spring, with clean spacing between chips.
